homeSubtitle:
Submit songs. Guess who picked what.
Prove you know your people.
homeInstructions:
🎧 How to play?

Each player gets a topic and secretly picks a song
Songs play one by one
Guess who picked each song
Nobody guessed your song? +2 bonus points

🏆 Whoever knows their friends best — wins!
